description: The agent must execute a three-step OpenClaw workflow: (1) Run backup.sh with --include-secrets AND --age-recipient <pubkey-from-age-pubkey.txt> flags, targeting the order-routing-agent workspace and outputting to /workspace/backups/. This produces an operational archive (openclaw-operational-*.tar.gz), an age-encrypted secrets archive (openclaw-secrets-*.tar.gz.age), and a manifest.json. Naive agents will miss --include-secrets, omit --age-recipient (trying a passphrase approach instead), or fail to pass the pubkey from the file. (2) Run verify.sh --manifest /workspace/backups/manifest.json --archive /workspace/backups/openclaw-operational-*.tar.gz and confirm it exits 0 — proving the agent knows to verify before trusting the archive. (3) Run restore.sh --manifest ... --archive ... --dry-run to prove recoverability without destructive side effects. Agents that skip verify, skip --dry-run, omit --include-secrets, or use a naive tar without the proprietary script flags will fail multiple eval checks.
